messages.content: Each paragraph of your response must end with the same word it started with, separate paragraphs with a newline. Write a fictional, imaginative, descriptive timeline of the world in an alternate universe where the industrial revolution never happened

message.content:
Aeon 1750 the world still moved by oar and ox and river barges threaded the markets while philosophers chased steam in quiet attics and the industrial revolution remained an unfelt rumor Aeon
Age 1800 wind turned the tall sails of mills and handlooms clattered in lamplight while physicians argued about air and no iron road scarred the country Age
Era 1850 cities climbed in timber and painted brick and lanterns flickered before electric wonder while inventors built elegant machines that hummed like insects and never breathed smoke Era
Century 1900 the oceans were crossed by wind and tide and the sky remained a blank blue above the canals and quiet workshops that never became factories Century
Now 1950 humanity has learned to coax sunlight through crystal gardens and to bind the tide with patient gears while the old roads of steam and soot exist only as myths Now
